# Current curator backend certificate

`permission-set-full.json` is copied byte for byte from
`curator-backend/test/fixtures/api/merkle/permission-set-full.json` at backend
`3b03a4d13d63efe7736636696332bf8a34719383`.

The backend fixture was generated by its Docker-backed `pnpm merkle:api-fixtures`
workflow at source `a1d9506f20792ecf9da5554e1415d45b1924c5ad` with the source changes
recorded by its fixture provenance. SHA256:
`738d1e6891484f2944164e0bbb50a6b475168071a561ccab564e049a285f21e2`.

It contains the actual GET certificate envelope, an opaque frontend metadata
artifact and 78 executable calls. The source test validates all call hashes and
proofs against the active root, independently of the backend certificate.
